name: warpos
description: WarpOS — autonomous AI operating system for software engineering. Registry-driven hooks, transactional updates, honest release gates, generic promotion.
notes: Critical install bug fixes for 0.4.0/0.4.1. (1) scripts/sprint/ and scripts/dispatch/ were missing from the manifest scan, so product repos installing 0.4.0/0.4.1 received the /sprint:* slash commands but not the backing engine scripts; 27 files missing per install. Added scripts/sprint as kind sprint_engine and scripts/dispatch as kind dispatch_engine. (2) install.ps1 wrote framework-installed.json via PowerShell 5.1's Out-File -Encoding utf8, which emits a UTF-8 BOM; JSON.parse rejects BOM so the snapshot was unreadable and /warp:update silently broke. Replaced with .NET WriteAllText + explicit no-BOM encoding. (3) install.ps1 never copied .claude/framework-manifest.json itself; the product's manifest stayed at whatever version it was at install time, so /warp:doctor reported manifest_stale forever. Now copied as part of Stage 2. All product repos must re-bootstrap via install.ps1 once to receive the missing scripts + the BOM-free snapshot + the refreshed manifest.
